title: Fantastic Experience!!

title: Fall in Love with Barcelona!
text:
Daniela was knowledgeable and personable. 
The time flew by as we learned and saw the many facets of Barcelona. 
Entertaining and insightful always, but Daniela also listened to us and answered our questions.
author: Gary_B

title: Fall in Love with Barcelona!
text:
Daniela was perfect!
She was knowledgeable, entertaining, and personable. 
Daniela listened to us and answered our questions, but most of all she helped us fall in love with Barcelona.
author: gbaughno

title: Worth it.
text: We did a half day tour with Daniela, she was fantastic. She picked us up at our hotel on time and accommodating to our needs. Very informative. A great way to experience parts of Barcelona by car & on foot. Worth the price.
author: Y4300YSlauram

title: Informative , culturally rich , interesting anecdotes and just refreshing
text: Katty really was super informed, prepared, friendly and knowledgeable . Her background and life experiences make her a very good guide. Everything was easy and comfortable. Katty loves her job and it was a pleasure to spend time with her.

title: Family Tour Barcelona
text: Our Tour guide Mario was fantastic . Very knowledgeable and informative . He was very happy to take us anywhere we wanted to go . He provided an excellent tour of the city for first time families in Barcelona . We highly recommend him .
